newsitem.title: UK: UK government confirms plan to replace Camelot.
newsitem.headline: UK government confirms plan to replace Camelot.

text.p: The government confirmed on Wednesday that it wants to take powers to seek a "competitive, not-for-profit operator" to replace Camelot Group Plc as the organiser of Britain's national lottery.

In a background note to the Queen's speech opening the new session of parliament, the government also said it would introduce a bill to allow lottery funds to be used to promote education, health and other initiatives which fall outside the services provided by taxes.
The government also said it would set up a National Endowment for Science and the Arts which would be launched using lottery funds.
The Labour Party said in its election manifesto that it wanted to replace Camelot when the company's seven-year contract to run the lottery expires. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
